input.rationale: Section 21 is mutual in form and carries a full Excluded Claims set (confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP), and 21.2 excludes indirect/consequential damages mutually. However the cap quantum is illusory: "Fees" is defined in 1.5 as only the Implementation Fee, which 1.6 fixes at a one-time USD 12,000 under the first Order Form, and 21.1 further limits the basis to the first Order Form. That is far below six months' fees and so fails the fallback "12 months of fees" element. Our edit changes only the basis to lowercase fees paid or payable under this Agreement and all Order Forms over the preceding twelve months; all carve-outs are already met. We note (without flagging) that the USD 1,000,000 floor is absent and that the payment carve-out in 21.3 uses the narrow defined "Fees", which fall short of the preferred position only.

proposal.summary: Fix illusory cap basis: 12 months of fees under the Agreement and all Order Forms
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The cap is tied to defined "Fees" (the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee) under the first Order Form only, so it is illusory; we align it to twelve months of fees under this Agreement and all Order Forms, consistent with our fallback position. Indemnities, confidentiality, data-protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and IP infringement remain uncapped as Excluded Claims.
